review:
I liked the story, the background music, the Sound Effects, and the artwork. And the voices were good overall, I felt they matched the characters that they were portraying very well.

I will complain that the voice volume would fluctuate wildly. It was never too soft, but the sound volume would significantly increase, then decrease back to the normal levels. There were times were the voice actor's words would be squished for a second, which rarely occurred. 

The one thing I wished they had done was include a sprite for the side characters. They had a full-figure for the main characters on-screen and would include their sprites next to the text box while speaking - which I think is unnecessary in my opinion.

Overall, it is worthwhile to read through at least once!

+ Beautiful artwork
+ Good length
+ Intriguing story
+ Script was well-written, though a few oxford commas would have helped in some places - that's just personal preference

What would have made this VN perfect is if there were more choices! Just to add more of an interactive element to the game. 

I also felt that the MC monologued a bit too much, but I understand that the writer needed to convey enough information in a short amount of time.

Spoiler: [spoiler] I found the whole father-daughter thing a little weird and created the wrong kind of tension between Chiyo and Kou. It would have been just as fine without Kou labeling Chiyo, and that way there'd be a bit more romantic tension between them. Perhaps the writer wanted that sort of weirdness. [/spoiler]

Overall, great VN. I look forward to part 2 if there is one!

Fair quality, for a free one-man-team game. Kinetic, takes ~2hrs with a somewhat slow reading speed.

Story -- some elements surprising to me, otherwise predictable

Characters -- I felt like this was ruined a bit by the deuteragonist being tsundere, with only an offhand justification. Maybe some inconsistence for plot convenience too?

Visual & sound -- Fair enough. I liked hair shading, which many anime-style pieces omit. More even distribution of CGs would be more interesting maybe?

68/100, eh

kinetic novel 动态小说， 是没有任何选项，但是背景、立绘、配音都是有的，作为一个免费游戏 wander no more也算是麻雀虽小 五脏俱全了。很喜欢整个游戏的画风以及主角鲜明的性格对比。人物的配音也是恰到好处，不多不少，需要的时候很完整，不需要的时候也绝对不会有。
虽然没有中文，但是阅读量并不大而且语句简单易懂，适合自己一个人无聊的时候玩，你会发现短短20分钟就能完成的游戏甚至并不太差，也算是意外惊喜了
男女主角之间关系微妙，男主强行认女儿，女主有点傲娇甚至看起来有点喜欢男主，可是他们的故事无关爱情，是关于一个迷途武士和大难不死的女孩在浩劫过后的hotsu村邂逅，女主角chiyo在村庄大火里活了下来，但是失去了一只手臂QAQ，武士Kouichirou因为自己武士组织的黑暗屠杀行为有悖于自己的武士道而叛出组织, 在救下了女孩之后的一年内两人慢慢变得亲密，chiyo得到的是亲情，Kou得到的是一次次的激励以及救赎。很短的剧情剧透了就真的没啥了，空了就玩下吧，就当听个故事。

It's a nice game. The vioce version is even better. Didn't feel like wasting any time to play this game. Good good good good. Without any choices, the story line is still interesting and relatively complete. It's hard to believe a free game can achieve this height. Like it.

Wander No More is a short visual novel I enjoyed.  I especially liked the way the art of Wander No More contrasts sharp characters that pop over soft and deep backgrounds that really set the tone of the VN. I would recommend this to any VN fans.

/!\ It is a Kinetic Novel (therefore, linear plot ➝ no choices involved) /!\
Duration: ~2.5h

Wander No More portrays an encouter between a qualified samurai and an enjured young lady. Both determined to survive slowly build back up their lives with diligence and form a significant bond.

[b]Pros:[/b]
✰ Nice art
✰ Peaceful BGM
✰ Voice acting
✰ Fair plot
✰ It's free

[b]Cons:[/b]
✰ You'll be wanting to read more of it

A cute little game I was looking forward to.

A story about a devoted samurai taking in a traumatized and injured young girl to care for based in a small village somewhere in Japan.

ART: 8.5
The background scenes were stunning and the detail in the character design was very impressive.

MUSIC: 7.5
The soundtrack was fairly limited in a sense that there wasn't too much variety. This could be due to the visual novel being fairly short which is respectable. Even though it was limited, each piece of the soundtrack was well suited for each scene thus, keeping me engaged.

STORY: 6
The story felt unique but also familiar to other plot lines we have all seen before, without saying too much and spoiling the story I will say that it was predictable in where it was heading. Although the story was short, it was well written but it needed a change of direction or an option of a choice maybe.

AUDIO DUB: 6.5
I was fairly impressed with the voice acting of Kyouichirou and Chiyo which was well fitted to their characters. The other characters well.....not so much as it felt almost cringy and awkward majority of the time.

OVERALL RATING: 7
Amazing artwork throughout the visual novel, an alluring soundtrack and unique characters. Although it was a short story I did enjoy it and would be looking forward to a sequel.

Very nice game, although the voice acting was kinda awkward, I really enjoyed the art style and short storyline. The characters were lovable overall and I would love to see a second. That cliffhanger or ending wasn't enough for me x3 so I will give this game a good job.
Sadly it was really short but it was still awesome! Hope there will be sequel. It would be amazing!
